About.label: 01 / About
About.heading: Turning ideas into useful
About.introduction: I'm a Next.js and TypeScript developer focused on building modern web experiences that are clear, practical, and genuinely useful.
About.approach: I approach development as a product problem: understand the goal, reduce complexity, and shape a maintainable solution around real user needs.
About.craft: My work centers on clean frontend architecture, thoughtful interfaces, and code that remains understandable as the product evolves.

product.title: Product thinking
product.description: Start with the problem, prioritize useful outcomes, and keep implementation aligned with purpose.

experience.description: Turn requirements into focused, accessible interfaces with sensible interactions and clear feedback.

performance.title: Performance & maintainability
performance.description: Favor efficient rendering, readable code, and practical decisions that support long-term reliability.
